description: This file contains utility functions for parsing and handling command-line arguments in a CLI application, including flag detection, command path extraction, and state migration logic.

methods.name: hasHelpOrVersion
methods.description: Checks if the command-line arguments include help or version flags.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Checks if a specific flag is present in the arguments.

methods.name: hasRootVersionAlias
methods.description: Determines if the root version alias flag is used in the arguments.

methods.name: isRootVersionInvocation
methods.description: Checks if the arguments invoke the root version command.

methods.name: isRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Checks if the arguments invoke the root help command.

methods.name: getFlagValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific flag.

methods.name: getVerboseFlag
methods.description: Determines if verbose or debug flags are set.

methods.name: getPositiveIntFlagValue
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a positive integer value for a given flag.

methods.name: getCommandPath
methods.description: Extracts the command path from arguments up to a specified depth.

methods.name: getCommandPathWithRootOptions
methods.description: Extracts the command path including root options.

methods.name: getPrimaryCommand
methods.description: Gets the primary command from the arguments.

methods.name: getCommandPositionalsWithRootOptions
methods.description: Parses positional arguments after command and options, considering root options.

methods.name: buildParseArgv
methods.description: Constructs the argument vector for the process, normalizing for runtime environments.

methods.name: shouldMigrateStateFromPath
methods.description: Determines if state migration should occur based on command path.

methods.name: shouldMigrateState
methods.description: Determines if state migration should occur based on full arguments.
